title: Building – Permit Refusal Residential Occupancy Alternative Solution October 2014
description: A developer applied to build a sprinklered multi-storey residential building on a sloping ravine site. Its stated aims were to reduce structural weight on poor soils and to drop the 2 h floor ratings.

refusal.basis: analogous: building permit refusal under Safety Codes Act s.44(3) for a proposed alternative solution (pre-dates the SCC variance form)

outcome_summary: Council confirmed the building permit refusal. Sprinklering was required under both classifications, so it was not an enhancement, and the building area also exceeded the 3.2.2.43 limit.
